tasks.title: Implement bounded prime63 pilot inputs, launcher and certificate checker

handoff.objective: Implement and unit-validate the bounded prime63 27-call pilot launcher, six deterministic planted inputs and independent full-point certificate checker without scientific solver trials.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the validated GF(p) backend can be wrapped in a sound 64-model guard, an externally bounded and fully retained 27-call schedule, and independent exact point certification.
constraints: No scientific trial: do not solve any of the 21 natural systems or any full-width planted ideal. Unit tests may use mocked calls and small-field exact examples only. Preserve every failed engineering attempt in raw logs.

Bind the archived backend.py SHA256 30f9310997833836b0ca7a080a84b5b4b2fcc4231167045d9636596dbd46b7c5, independent_check.py SHA256 10ee7807e00e16ef9c5f109023c53783773a82167987889f93abbbf06b99470f, and source receipt SHA256 fed430d468ea07b6dc05b44e32ec191d494cfeadcf112acb0a9636c394bb440a. Bind the five prime input hashes, both encoder hashes and the pinned Sage binary hash in input_manifest.json; exact integers above 2^53 may never pass through floating JSON.

Generate six separate public positive systems, m=2 and m=8 for each of coset, random and small_x. Use each frozen 475-point base without target-conditioned selection; deterministic SHA256 domain ICPERF-PRIME63-PLANTED-V1, arm, m and index with rejection log for repeated x, infinity sums or collision with seven public targets. Select signs deterministically and retain checker-only signed witnesses separately. Reuse the archived direct system encoder; use quadratic_lift for coset and direct for both controls. Public solver requests contain target points and equations but no planted witness or scalar.

Independent check_inputs.py must rederive all six target point sums, base membership, coset gates, serialized polynomial zeros and modified-root rejection in Sage without importing emit_inputs.py or the backend evaluator. If any check fails, mark input preparation invalid and stop.

Implement a conservative pre-variety 64-primary-model bound. One acceptable candidate is a zero-dimensional GB leading-ideal standard-monomial count stopped at 65; if quotient dimension exceeds 64, label model_cap_censored before ideal.variety(). Prove the guard on >64 distinct-root and repeated-root small-field controls. If no sound bound is implemented, engineering_validation must fail readiness; truncating an already enumerated variety is not a cap.

Implement an external one-process supervisor for later approved calls: 300 seconds per call, 8 GiB process-tree RSS, 64 primary models, at most 4 hours whole panel, bounded SSD990-2 task-specific DOT_SAGE/TMPDIR with 16 GiB free at start, 8 GiB minimum continuing free, and 8 GiB scratch stop. Capture exact command, binary/source/input hashes, head/dirty-tree state, UTC times, CPU, wall, sampled peak RSS, scratch bytes, stdout, stderr and every per-call attempt. A watchdog stop is censored; process exit or sampled guard is not an execution proof.

The future panel schedule is exactly six positives then all 21 archived common-target systems, m=2..8 by arm, at equal caps. A false root or failed independent control invalidates the panel; timeout, memory and model cap retain raw output and attempted/unattempted counts. A positive cap does not establish no relation. No full-cost IC or speed claim follows.

verify_run.py must independently check every returned root satisfies every polynomial, all base membership and coset constraints, x-lifting, signed point sum equal to the full target point, altered-sign and altered-target false-object controls, and exact raw-file/tar-manifest coverage. It must not accept a point-only witness with no polynomial root or an x-only match.

Keep the engineering source and input files in this task directory. Large Sage scratch stays local-only. Deliver all eighteen fixed artifact paths or classify the engineering task failed; no placeholder success receipt.
